headline: Two Filipino Seafarers Killed in Strait of Hormuz Tanker Attack
seoTitle: 2 Filipino Seafarers Killed in Hormuz Attack | FMB News
seoDescription: The DMW confirmed two Filipino seafarers died after the Saudi-flagged tanker SIDR was attacked in the Strait of Hormuz; government agencies are assisting their families.
deck: The deaths renewed calls for strict enforcement of Filipino seafarers' right to refuse voyages through designated high-risk areas.
author: FMB News Desk

sections.heading: What happened
paragraphs: The Department of Migrant Workers confirmed that two Filipino seafarers were killed after the Saudi-flagged crude oil tanker SIDR was attacked while transiting the Strait of Hormuz.

The Philippine government said the victims were from Cabuyao, Laguna, and Daanbantayan, Cebu, and ordered agencies to provide their families with applicable benefits, compensation and insurance assistance.

sections.heading: Right to refuse dangerous voyages
paragraphs: Senator Raffy Tulfo called on the DMW to ensure that manning agencies and shipping companies respect Filipino seafarers' right to refuse sailing through designated high-risk areas without losing benefits.

sections.heading: Why it matters
paragraphs: The attack highlights the direct exposure of Filipino maritime workers to geopolitical conflict along major global shipping routes.

sections.heading: What to watch next
paragraphs: Families and surviving crew members will be watching the delivery of compensation, insurance, repatriation support and enforcement of high-risk-area protections.
